missing_note: These metadata rows point at .m4a paths that are not in the repository -- one speaker's entire session. They are reported rather than dropped silently (CLAUDE.md: never silently drop clips). Nothing downstream sees them.
shared_speaker_note: The 'marco' folder is recorded by the same person as E3's speaker1, so it carries the id 'speaker1'. Any combination of E6-train and an E3 evaluation therefore trips assert_speaker_disjoint rather than passing quietly with the same voice on both sides.
text_sentiment_note: text_sentiment is assigned by hand from the sentence text (see TEXT_SENTIMENT in scripts/build_zurich.py); the dataset itself labels intended DELIVERY only. Ambiguous wordings are left NEUTRAL rather than forced to a side, so PSI here measures the model and not the labelling. It remains the analyst's judgment and is the one derived column in this manifest.
